# FIXTURE, not a measurement. Same shape as the others but measured in SECONDS.
#
# Exists solely to prove the unit check has teeth: the digits here would look
# plausible next to a millisecond claim, and a gate that compared only numbers
# would accept them. parse_boot_times() must report unit "s", and the claims
# gate must treat "s" against a claim declaring "ms" as a HARD failure.
run 1: 1000 s
run 2: 1020 s
run 3: 1040 s
